name: Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co.,Ltd is involved in the research and development, production, manufacturing, and sales of precision metal structural components and electronic components for liquid crystal displays in China and internationally. The company offers precision-stamped metal back panels, rear shells, heat sinks, reinforcing plates, metal front frames, bases, and brackets. It also provides production and sales of computing power products and power cloud services. Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co.,Ltd was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Yixing, China.
